---
applyTo: "**/src/test/**/*.java"
---


# Test Instructions


- Use JUnit 5.
- Use Arrange / Act / Assert.
- Test behavior rather than implementation details.
- Include happy path tests.
- Include Not Found tests.
- Include missing-field tests.
- Include invalid-input tests.
- Include external failure tests where applicable.
- Use Mockito only when mocking is justified.
- Test names should describe expected behavior.
